Chapter 6933: Mortal Power

Chapter 6933: Mortal Power

“Galaxy Flow.” Perpetual whispered and adorned a pair of gauntlets stretching to his shoulders. This could only be possible through the hands of a resourceful immortal.

When he took action, nothing destructive erupted. His gauntlets moved with precision and stealth, appearing from an unknown angle of time and space.

Li Qiye’s body seemed to turn into rippling liquid, or rather, the area around him. The gauntlets attempted to trace Li Qiye’s source to kill him at his weakest.

This was his ace card, interfering with the timeline through the gauntlets. Unfortunately, he couldn’t find anything at Li Qiye’s birth.

It was as if his hands entered a boundless domain; Heavenrealm itself was tiny in comparison. He had never experienced anything like this before.

A more powerful immortal would have stopped or banished his technique. However, he was able to enter Li Qiye’s timeline but couldn’t sense anything. The scope of this timeline exceeded his imagination.

How could a cell comprehend the vastness of Heavenrealm?

“Pop!” He realized the danger but couldn’t pull back in time. An unknown force pulverized both his hands and the prized gauntlets.

“Ugh...” He staggered backward and vomited blood.

“What power is this?!” He shouted in astonishment. His gauntlet could withstand the power of any golden immortal.

Thus, this man had to be at the primordial level or higher, given his nonchalant retaliation.

“Mortal.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Ridiculous!” He barked back.

“What you think matters not, it is time to die.” Li Qiye smiled and walked forward.

“Perpetual!” He shouted and released a blinding radiance. Timeflow had to close his eyes.

The whole galaxy wrapped around him, allowing him to assume his true form.

“Absolute Refinement!” His voice echoed and the galaxy collapsed.

Several worlds nearby were twisted chaotically, on the verge of collapsing to become one with him.

“Ahh!” Living beings looked up as the sky cracked. Space and time no longer maintained order. Emperors and ancient ancestors were helpless, unable to stop the changes.

“An immortal is doing this!” One overlord shouted and ran away. This world could no longer be saved.

“Bam!” Suddenly, the whole galaxy collapsed into fragments and the pull disappeared, sparing the nearby worlds.

When visibility returned, Li Qiye had captured and immobilized Perpetual’s physical body.

Perpetual was scared out of his mind. His ultimate technique didn’t even have the chance to start before it was defeated. From beginning to end, he couldn’t grasp Li Qiye’s movement at all. Now, he felt like an ant, unable to move an inch.
